description: Everything SuliHuli holds on one electric vehicle: range per test cycle (WLTP, EPA, CLTC, NEDC), charging, efficiency, battery and the other specs, prices per market and version with their dates, and every figure's source link, date and status (verified or unverified; where sources disagree, each figure is shown with its source, never averaged). The headline figures describe one named version; the answer lists every version we know with what is sourced for each (full, partial or name only). For another version pass `version` (name words such as 'long range awd', or a key from that list) and get that version's own figures. Photos come with their credit. Use it to answer any question about a specific model, quoting the figure with its cycle, source and status. Returns Markdown with the canonical page URL, plus the same figures as structured fields.

slug.description: Model slug as search_models returns it (also the last part of the page URL https://sulihuli.com/m/<slug>), e.g. 'hyundai-ioniq-6'. A version slug such as 'tesla-model-y-long-range-awd' also works.

version.description: Optional: a version key or name words, e.g. 'long range awd'. Without it the answer describes the named version and lists the others.

value.description: The figure as shown; units are in the field name (km, kwh, kw, min, s, kg...).
